views.markdown:
Hides jailbreak files, dyld images, Sileo/Filza URL schemes, and Frida port probes **without** disabling tweak injection.

Works while other tweaks and Frida stay loaded. Do **not** turn on Dopamine Hide Jailbreak if you want injection.
- Work with **Choicy**: do not hook `dlopen` (that blocked ChoicyLoader / libSandy) and never install hide hooks in SpringBoard, SplashBoard, or other system UI.
- Fix instant InstaPay / Ana Vodafone abort: do **not** hook `getenv` (recursive `os_unfair_lock` when Dynatrace / CFLog read the environment). Strip `DYLD_*` once at start instead.

- InstaPay / Ana Vodafone were still seeing injected images after launch (`objc_copyImageNames`, `task_info` compact lists, nameless trampoline pages, `DYLD_*`, `libsandy` / `libroot`). Hide those too.

- Fix InstaPay / Ana Vodafone launch crash: install hide hooks **before** those apps’ own jailbreak checks (no delayed main-queue install).
- Omit tweak images from `_dyld_image_count` / `task_info` again **without** writing dyld’s read-only list (the Dasher SIGBUS).
- Always hide in InstaPay and Ana Vodafone when Knighty is enabled.
- Hooks install **only** in apps enabled in Knighty Applicationlist. Other apps load Knighty but do nothing (fixes system apps crashing). Turn on DoorDash Dasher there, then respring.

- Honor **Knighty Applicationlist** when All Applications is off (read jb prefs; do not treat a missing bundle id as “every app”).
- Fix App Store crash on open: do not call `NSBundle hasPrefix` during dyld init; skip `AppStore` by process name.
- Hide VPN is its own Settings section (VPN stays connected; apps just do not see it).
- App picker is its own Settings row: **Knighty Applicationlist** (same icon, search bar, switches off by default). Uses AltList’s bundleless entry so Settings does not load it until you tap.
- Fix Settings crash on open: do not run ObjC / load AltList in Preferences’ constructor (`SIGSEGV` PAC in `NSArray`).

- Hide VPN defaults to **off**.
- Fix app list: load AltList inside Settings, and add a **Knighty Applications** page (opa334 bundleless entry) so the picker is not an empty PSListItemsController.
- Fix Dasher abort: do not `freeifaddrs` individual `getifaddrs` nodes (Darwin uses one allocation; Network’s `if_nametoindex` crashed with `POINTER_BEING_FREED_WAS_NOT_ALLOCATED`).
- Hide VPN from apps (`getifaddrs` utun/ipsec, proxy scoped interfaces, Network path `.other`). Toggle: Settings → Knighty → Hide VPN. The VPN itself stays on.
- Fix Dasher launch crash: do not write into dyld’s read-only image list (`SIGBUS` in `KnightyInstallDyldHooks`).

- Hide actually takes effect: intercept `dlsym` lookups, kernel `__stat64` / `__connect`, and omit tweak images from `_dyld_image_count`.
- Fix Enabled Applications: use AltList’s `PSLinkListCell` (no broken bundle path).

- Close scanners that skip libc: hook `syscall`, `getattrlist`, `task_info` image lists, IPv6 Frida ports, and Sileo/Filza install checks.
- Crane, Ghost, and Frida stay loaded. Port 27042 is only refused *from the app*, not from your computer.
- App picker is back inside Knighty → Enabled Applications. AltList loads only when that row is opened (rootless bundle path), not at SpringBoard start.
- Restore the app picker without Safe Mode: AltList is a separate Settings page (Knighty Applications) using opa334’s official bundleless entry. Nothing is loaded at SpringBoard start.
- Fix Safe Mode: do not dlopen AltList at process start. That crashed SpringBoard.
- Fix Enabled Applications bundle error: do not lazy-load AltList.bundle (null path on rootless). Preload AltList in Settings instead.
- Remove huge logo from the Sileo package description
- Fix empty Enabled Applications page: load AltList as a real controller (`bundle`, `isController`, `overridePrincipalClass`)
- Actually fix Settings: PreferenceLoader reads items at the plist root, not nested inside entry. That error screen was an empty specifier list.

- Remove huge icon from the GitHub README
- Fix Settings pane: use PreferenceLoader’s PLCustomListController so the switches actually load
- Fix Settings error: do not load KnightyPrefs.bundle (no missing executable). Pane is a PreferenceLoader plist only.

- Stop Settings crash: no custom prefs binary (Linux arm64e ABI was killing Settings on A12/A13)
- Settings pane is stock PSListController + AltList
- Do not install hooks in Settings at all
- Knighty icon in Settings, Sileo, and the repo
- Fix Settings crash when opening Knighty (don’t load AltList on the main page; never hook Settings)

- Build arm64 and arm64e so Settings / A12+ can load the prefs bundle
- Fix publish so Sileo actually gets the new version

- Settings app pane (like Crane)
- Per-app enable list via AltList
- Toggles for filesystem, tweaks, URLs, Frida ports, debugger

- Package display name is Knighty (not Veil)
- Compile fix for Sileo skip path

- Do not hook Sileo / apt / Filza / Dopamine (this was breaking Sileo)
- Guard ObjC hooks so they stay off in package managers

- Initial release for Dopamine 3 / iOS 18
- Filesystem, dyld, URL scheme, and Frida port hooks
